channel.title: The Elegant Sip Journal
channel.description: Craft, sourcing, and the ritual of brewing. Notes from the gardens behind Elegant Sip's single-origin teas.

item.title: Reading the Seasons: First, Second and Autumn Flush
item.description: One garden can give you three very different teas in a single year. A simple guide to what each flush tastes like, and how to brew it.

item.title: Why Altitude Shapes the Cup
item.description: Cool nights, thin air and slow growth. What height does to a tea leaf, and why so much of the best Darjeeling is grown high up.

item.title: Keeping Your Tea Fresh at Home
item.description: Light, air, heat and strong smells are what fade a good tea. A few easy habits that keep every cup tasting the way it did on day one.

item.title: The Art of the First Flush
item.description: The first harvest of spring is a race against the sun. Why the earliest pluck of the year commands the highest prices, and the most patience.

item.title: A Field Guide to Steeping
item.description: Temperature, time, leaf amount, and the often-misunderstood art of the re-steep. Everything you need to stop guessing and start tasting.

item.title: From Mist to Cup: Our Sourcing Journey
item.description: No auction houses, no middlemen, no anonymity. How we built direct relationships with the gardens that grow the leaves we sell.
